CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah.
CHAPTER.VERS: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
Jehovah loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God! Selah
I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to those who know me; behold, O Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia: this one was born there.
And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man have been born in her; and the Most High shall establish her.
Jehovah will take account, when He registers the peoples: This one was born there. Selah
Both the singers and the players on pipes say, All my springs are in you.
